classification.estimated_stack_gain: ask represented and every currently blocked premise carries the class label
classification.fully_read: direct fact exists and no unconsumed unknown, ambiguous, unmet-obligation, or unread truth-scoping unit remains
classification.primary_blocker: not assigned; no ordering is inferred from classifier branch order
classification.stack_ready: ask/query represented; every premise fully read; a fact key overlaps the query; no collision, quarantine, ambiguous reading, or clause-split hazard (same-value agreement dedupes are diagnostic, not blocking)

label_definitions.ambiguous-sense: one or more unconsumed premise units retain an ambiguous sense
label_definitions.compound-generic: bare plural compound subject used generically
label_definitions.coordination: and/or/either/neither coordination in an unread premise
label_definitions.entity-absent: no represented conclusion key appears in premise text or fact keys
label_definitions.entity-atoms-unrelated: premise facts exist but none overlaps the represented conclusion
label_definitions.entity-in-raw-if: a conclusion key appears in an unread if-premise
label_definitions.entity-in-raw-or: a conclusion key appears in an unread or-premise
label_definitions.entity-raw-other: a conclusion key appears in an otherwise unread zero-fact premise
label_definitions.paraphrase-gap: premise and conclusion keys share tokens but neither contains the other
label_definitions.passive: be + participial predicate, usually with a by-agent
label_definitions.raw-if: if-bearing premise with no direct conditional-family fact
label_definitions.raw-or: or-bearing premise with no direct disjunction-family fact
label_definitions.scope-ambiguous-universal: all-subject universal with surface not scope
label_definitions.truth-scope-veto: a truth-scoping unit is not consumed by a logic reader
label_definitions.unknown-vocabulary: one or more unconsumed premise units are unknown
label_definitions.unmet-obligation: a required obligation on an unconsumed premise unit is unmet
label_definitions.zero-fact-other: blocked premise emits no direct fact and matches no narrower class
